Hymn 275: Men Are That They Might Have Joy
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Hal K. Campbell
Lyricist/Text Author: Oscar Schaum
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 275 titled "Men Are That They Might Have Joy" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Hal K. Campbell and the lyrics were written by Oscar Schaum.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
